# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 5 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 7 tokens; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 16 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 8 tokens; Radius — 5 tokens; Shadow — 1 token; Size — 6 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--canvas, #ffffff);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--canvas` | #ffffff | True white base: primary nav, modals, feature cards, page body. |
| `--surface-soft` | #fbfbf9 | Faint cream wash behind the home hero. |
| `--surface-card` | #f6f6f3 | Warm-cream fill for pin cards, category tiles, search bar, filter chips, icon buttons, disabled buttons. |
| `--surface-elevated` | #ffffff | Surfaces lifted over the scrim (modal card). |
| `--surface-dark` | #262622 | Warm near-black for the rare dark CTA strip. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--primary, #6b1d2f);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #6b1d2f;
```

### Tokens (16)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--primary` | #6b1d2f | The one saturated color. Primary CTAs (Sign up, Continue, Get started), the active-tab indicator and the wordmark only. At most one red CTA per fold. White text on it is 4.8:1. |
| `--primary-pressed` | #f1f5f9 | Pressed state of the primary button: one notch deeper than primary. |
| `--body` | #33332e | Default paragraph text on canvas (12.6:1). |
| `--charcoal` | #262622 | Slightly softer body where pure ink is too heavy. |
| `--mute` | #62625b | Metadata, footer links, secondary captions (6.2:1 on canvas). |
| `--ash` | #777772 | Placeholder text, disabled labels, the 1px text-input border. 3.2:1 on canvas: never for text people must read. |
| `--stone` | #c8c8c1 | Least-emphasis utility marks and disabled borders. Decorative only. |
| `--secondary-bg` | #e5e5e0 | Secondary button fill: one notch deeper than surface-card. |
| `--secondary-pressed` | #c8c8c1 | Pressed state of the secondary button. |
| `--scrim` | rgba(0,0,0,0.5) | The 50% overlay behind modal cards. |
| `--focus-outer` | #435ee5 | Outer ring of the focus stack on every focusable element. |
| `--focus-inner` | #ffffff | White gap inside the focus ring. |
| `--error` | #6b1d2f | Validation messages and destructive copy (8.6:1 on canvas). |
| `--error-deep` | #9d0018 | Deeper error fill where error needs more weight. Same value as primary-pressed, different meaning. |
| `--success-deep` | #103c25 | Success message text; on success-pale it reads 10:1. |
| `--success-pale` | #c7f0da | Background of a success pill. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 70px/1.1 Inter, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -1.2px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -1.2px;
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 70px / 1.1, letter-spacing -1.2px | 600 | `sans` | Top-of-page hero headline only. Scales 56 / 44 / 36px down the breakpoints. |
| `display-lg` | `.display-lg`, `--text-display-lg` | 44px / 1.15, letter-spacing -0.8px | 700 | `sans` | Secondary hero on creator and business pages. |
| `heading-xl` | `.heading-xl`, `--text-heading-xl` | 28px / 1.2, letter-spacing -1.2px | 700 | `sans` | Section headings, feature-card headlines, dark CTA strip. |
| `heading-lg` | `.heading-lg`, `--text-heading-lg` | 22px / 1.25 | 600 | `sans` | Sub-section heading, modal title. |
| `heading-md` | `.heading-md`, `--text-heading-md` | 18px / 1.3 | 600 | `sans` | Card titles, in-grid labels. |
| `body-md` | `.body-md`, `--text-body-md` | 16px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | Default paragraph, modal body. |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 16px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Inline emphasis, primary nav links, form labels. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | Footer copy, pin metadata, helper text. |
| `body-sm-strong` | `.body-sm-strong`, `--text-body-sm-strong` | 14px / 1.4 | 700 | `sans` | Result counts, footer column headers, avatar names. |
| `link-md` | `.link-md`, `--text-link-md` | 16px / 1.4 | 600 | `sans` | Inline anchor in body prose, colored ink-soft. |
| `caption-md` | `.caption-md`, `--text-caption-md` | 12px / 1.5 | 500 | `sans` | Captions, link metadata. |
| `caption-sm` | `.caption-sm`, `--text-caption-sm` | 12px / 1.4 | 400 | `sans` | Copyright and the smallest utility text. |
| `button-md` | `.button-md`, `--text-button-md` | 14px / 1 | 700 | `sans` | Primary and secondary button labels, filter chips. |
| `button-sm` | `.button-sm`, `--text-button-sm` | 12px / 1 | 700 | `sans` | Overlay pills and compact in-card buttons. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Inter, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

8px base with finer 4 / 6px steps for tight inline gaps.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-xxs);
```

### Tokens (8)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-xxs` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap inside pills. |
| `--space-xs` | 6px | Vertical padding in buttons; mobile pin-grid gutter. |
| `--space-sm` | 8px | Pin-grid gutter (both axes): images nearly touch. |
| `--space-md` | 12px | Gap between chips; overlay inset from a pin edge. |
| `--space-lg` | 16px | Category-tile padding; form-field gap. |
| `--space-xl` | 24px | Page side gutter at desktop; footer horizontal padding. |
| `--space-xxl` | 32px | Modal and feature-card padding; mobile section gap. |
| `--space-section` | 64px | Vertical rhythm between major sections (48px tablet, 32px mobile). |

## Radius

Three radii in active use: 16px, 32px and pill. Nothing between 16 and 32; no square interactive elements.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--radius-none: 0px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--radius-none), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (5)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--radius-none` | 0px | Structural bands only: nav, footer, page sections, dark CTA strip. |
| `--radius-sm` | 8px | Rare: an editorial tooltip. |
| `--radius-md` | 16px | Buttons, inputs, pin cards, feature cards, category tiles: the default. |
| `--radius-lg` | 32px | Large feature pins and modal cards. |
| `--radius-full` | 9999px | Search bar, filter chips, overlay pills, icon buttons, avatars. |

## Shadow

Content surfaces are flat. The only shadow sits under the modal card.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--shadow-modal: 0 0 16px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12)) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-modal), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-modal` | 0 0 16px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12) | Ambient 16px shadow under modal-card, over the scrim. |

## Size

Fixed control heights.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below (--size-button: 40px) */
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--size-button), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--size-button` | 40px | Primary and secondary button height. |
| `--size-icon-button` | 40px | Circular icon button (hit area padded to 48px). |
| `--size-input` | 44px | Text input height. |
| `--size-search` | 48px | Search bar height. |
| `--size-nav` | 64px | Primary nav height. |
| `--size-content` | 1280px | Max content width at desktop. |
